# opnsense_firewall_group (Data Source)

Firewall groups allow multiple interfaces to be grouped together and referenced as a single firewall interface.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description for this firewall group.
- `members` (Set of String) Interfaces that belong to this firewall group.
- `name` (String) The name of the firewall group.
- `no_group` (String) Whether the group is excluded from automatically generated interface groups.
- `sequence` (Number) The sequence number used to order firewall groups.
